question: 다음 작은 예산 검증은 50칸과 100칸 중 어느 쪽을 먼저 볼까?
proposedControls: Reuse all 30 dense edited maps, prior valid routes, current starts/goals and A* FIFO; change only the per-call budget from 300 to the selected value. Compare forced reoptimization and guarded default on identical inputs. No sampling or wall reselection.
proposedMeasures: Separate usable-route preservation from successful new optimization, bound proofs, search completions, budget-exceeded raw results/valid fallbacks, returned distance versus archived independent BFS, missed possible shortening and new node expansions. A budget failure must not be labeled UNREACHABLE.
knownPriorEvidence: Same cohort and full-search expansion counts are already available, so this is a guided budget/fallback control, not blind new research or an independent map cohort.
scope: Unexecuted draft. AI provides options/method/code; student budget selection pending. No new physical, runtime or energy measurement.
